remarks: Experience true waterfront living at Charles Cove, one of the area's most sought-after gated communities with pool, tennis, scenic boardwalk, and direct water access. Calf Pasture beach is in walking distance and well as a dog park. This exceptional 3-bedroom, 3-bath townhouse offers a private 62' dock (B-18) just steps from your deck-wake up and see your boat right from your bed. Perfect for boating enthusiasts, this is a rare opportunity to enjoy the convenience of having your vessel outside your door. Inside, the home is move-in ready and designed for comfort, style, and entertaining. A Deane kitchen with premium cabinetry and wine fridge flows into spacious dining and living areas with Brazilian cherry floors, custom built-ins, a wood-burning fireplace, and sliding doors that open to a sun-filled deck with sweeping sunset views over the water. Whether hosting friends or enjoying a quiet evening, the open layout seamlessly blends indoor and outdoor living. The first-floor primary suite is a private retreat with spa-like finishes, including marble details, a steam shower, Bain Ultra air-jet tub, heated floors, and triple-paned windows with built-in blinds. Each bedroom features its own ensuite bath, offering privacy for family and guests, with flexible options on both the first and second floors. Upstairs, a spacious guest suite and a light-filled third-floor loft with skylights and abundant storage provide versatility for additional bedrooms, a home office.
